message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in Europeans**

| Population | Allele | Frequency |
|------------|--------|-----------|
| European (overall, 1000 Genomes Phase 3) | **C** (the “ε2”‑associated allele) | ~0.12 (≈ 12 %) |
| European (overall, gnomAD v3.1) | **C** | ~0.11–0.13 (≈ 11–13 %) |

*The most common allele at this locus in Europeans is the **T** allele (~88 %), so the variant allele (C) is present in roughly one in eight individuals.*

> **Sources**  
> • 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 – European superpopulation (EUR) allele counts for rs7412.  
> • gnomAD v3.1 (Exome + Genome) – allele frequencies for rs7412 in the European ancestry group.

**Note:** Frequencies can differ slightly between sub‑European groups (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europeans), but the overall range remains close to 10–13 % for the C allele.
